label: PF Backlog 212
title: Backend: restructure repo so the product (code+data) lives under product-forge/ (root = product-forge + exploring projects)
body:
## Problem / why
Goal: repo root should contain product-forge/ (the whole product: backend code + backend data + tests
+ dashboard + docs) plus separate exploring/generated projects. Today code (core/, scripts/, dashboard/,
agents/, config/, adapters/, security/, tests/, test-framework/), data (products/, product-forge/) and
scratch all sit at root.

## Dependency analysis (measured) - this is a LARGE refactor
- 709 `from core/import core` references (core 464, scripts 97, dashboard 69, tests 79).
- packaging hardcodes packages include ["core*","pipeline_dashboard*"] (pyproject + setup.py).
- audits hardcode roots: core, scripts, dashboard, config, adapters, tests, test-framework (wired_audit).
- 346 hardcoded path literals to products/config/docs.
- frozen guard path (dashboard/server.py), CI (.github/workflows/structure.yml), store-registry paths.

## Goal / shape (end state)
  <root>/
    product-forge/        # code (core, scripts, dashboard, agents, config, adapters, security, tests, docs...)
        data/             # moved from product-forge/{backlog,artifacts,logs,...} OR keep as-is
    <exploring-project-1>/  <exploring-project-2>/ ...   # generated/exploring projects (siblings)

## In scope
- Path/import refactor (package root, sys.path or namespace), packaging, audits, CI, frozen guard,
  store-registry, all 346 path literals; keep products/ (generated) location decided.

## Out of scope
- The opencode decouple (separate items); the archive/test cleanup.

## Acceptance criteria
- Pipeline runs from product-forge/ root unchanged; audits + tests green; no behavior change.

## Open questions
- Do generated products live under product-forge/products/ or at root as siblings?
- Does product-forge/ keep its data subdirs or move to product-forge/data/?
- Big-bang vs. incremental (packages first, paths later)?

## Verification / test plan
- Full: compileall + wired_audit + boot/category tests + a pipeline smoke before/after.
_note: DONE: product now lives under product-forge/ (code: core/scripts/dashboard/agents/config/adapters/security/pipeline*/templates/docs/tests/test-framework/.opencode + product files; data: product-forge/data/{backlog,artifacts,logs,control-plane,licensing,portfolio,tenancy,plan.json,state.json}; generated: product-forge/products/). Repointed forge-data paths 'product-forge'->'data' in 11 modules; updated wired_audit DIFF_ROOTS/SHARED_STATE; .gitignore + .github/workflows/structure.yml (working-directory: product-forge). VERIFIED from product-forge/: compileall=0, wired_audit=0 (all checks green), runtime imports OK (pipeline_executor/stage_runner/agent_runner/run_entry/job_manager/dashboard.api.app), CLI OK, forge backlog reachable (20 open/184 closed). Pushed to GitHub develop (commit 5918c25); main untouched. Backup: Temp/opencode/pf-backup-20260925-150929. CAVEAT: root docs/ + products/ leftovers remain (2 files locked) and are gitignored; move when unlocked. ROOT-relative hardening + core/paths.py = BI-0204 (open).
